criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: The lot works as a measured image on 2. Slide 8 figure beside the wheel, slumped, no windshield road. Slide 6 skyline small boxes, foreground packed rows not tail rows. Slide 3 dim mass at thumb, leaders on dark cars. Slide 4 lone car in front of packed rows, empty bays featureless, mid-tone haze band. Slide 5 grey plate with thin graduations.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck, one key, one stand-in car, dusk_gold stripe on 1, 2, 3 and 9, motif changes state. The stripe on slide 4 whose plan says accent none, and slide 8's grey interior sits outside the deck.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to claims.json or figures.json, all sources primary, rejections honoured. Slide 8 present tense from c64; caption's one car per ten is untrue of scenery on 4 and 6.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Deciding body, terms, a concrete conflict on 6, the enforcement line on 7 and an action on 9. Never says where in Texas these vehicles run, no next step or date for lawmakers.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays at once, turn at 5 and 6, 9 closes on an action. Slide 4 cuttable, slide 8 loosely connected.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register. Some lines read as an engine describing itself (slide 4 It draws as the lot's last car, slide 2 rounded, and never fewer than one). Slide 9 closes flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Unit lot is new, but no. 52 shipped a white robotaxi in lastLight on a dark lot 27 days ago, AVs fourth subject in 30 days, slide 8's Dallas to Laredo lane echoes no. 67.

one_sentence_fix: Make the pictures show what their own copy says: rebuild slide 8 so the person sits behind the wheel facing a windshield with the road and seam, and recompose slides 4 and 6 so their foregrounds are the near-empty tail rows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Figure beside the wheel, head slumped like a sleeping mannequin, no windshield or road, reads as a grey cab wall.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera from the passenger seat looking forward-left so the wheel sits in front of the figure's chest, head up, windshield open to the lit road and seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Skyline a row of tiny boxes on a ruled line, foreground packed full rows rather than tail rows.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Foreground the lot's last rows from FIG.units (single cars, empty bays, stops casting right); a larger hazed skyline sitting into the seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Third column a dim mass at thumb size, blurred black foreground, leaders on unlit cars, rank order unreadable.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake the low sun down the third column's rows, drop the defocused foreground rows, frame from Avride's lit nearest row to the single cars.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lone car directly in front of packed rows, empty bays a featureless dark foreground, brown mid-tone haze band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower camera to wheel-stop height, light the stops so each casts long toward the car, push packed rows back and darker, remove the stray peach stripe.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Relief reads as a large grey plate with faint graduations, the no-end run is a short stub.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop so the stop block sits at the left third and the gold groove at the centre, half the frame of graduations running off the right edge, deeper grooves catching the key.
